title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Blue Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Blue Raspberry delivers an intense burst of tangy and sweet berry flavour. The unmistakable taste of Blue Raspberry blends deep, jammy notes with a sharp, candy-like tang, creating a bold and vibrant vape with a lingering fruity finish. Part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Blue Raspberry is designed to replicate the punchy, layered flavours commonly found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures a long-lasting depth of flavour while providing a consistently smooth vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid strikes a balance between vapour production and flavour intensity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their dedication to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a favourite among vapers. MTL (mouth-to-lung)
